issues.criterion: build-rules §5 (brand logo 3-tier fallback; ship /themes/<id>/logo.png) + spec Layout 'logo (3-tier fallback)' + AC1 (plaque shows the logo)
issues.description: The header brand identity renders as a broken-image placeholder + raw alt text ('Redgate Lodge Motor Group') on every route and width, including inside the plaque (the component's unique move, AC1). Root cause confirmed: this brand has no brand.logo, so BrandLogo falls to tier-2 THEME_LOGO '/themes/redgate-lodge-bespoke/logo.png' — which returns HTTP 404 (public/themes/redgate-lodge-bespoke/ ships no asset). Build-rules §5 requires that theme default logo.png be shipped. Secondary defect: when both image tiers fail, BrandLogo's onError should degrade to the styled wordmark, but the wordmark does NOT render in the captured (post-networkidle) page — the broken +alt persists. Fix: ship /themes/redgate-lodge-bespoke/logo.png AND verify the onError->wordmark fallback actually paints so a logo-less brand degrades cleanly.

issues.route: mobile overlay (code-verified; open-state not screenshottable from a static shot)
issues.description: The full-screen overlay hardcodes the UI labels 'Wishlist', 'Compare' and 'WhatsApp us' instead of routing them through resolveText(brand, key). Generic (not dealer-specific), so no preview-leak risk — polish only. text-recipe.json already defines footer.wishlist/footer.compare that could be reused.

context_notes: This QA brand has no phone number and no city/county (getBrandContactInfo returned 'undefined, undefined'), so the contact-strip location chip and phone link are correctly hidden by defensive rendering (contact.locationLabel && / contact.phoneTel &&). Left side of the strip is therefore empty on mobile and desktop — data-driven, not a header bug. Status chip correctly shows the 'By appointment & walk-in' fallback (never 'Closed'), satisfying the States requirement.

The white gradient on the right edge of every screenshot is a theme-shots capture artifact (right-edge fade), not a header shadow or a blank CTA. The primary CTA label 'Sell my car' is confirmed present in the served HTML with the correct .cta{background:--color-primary;color:--color-on-primary} pair — AC4/CTA render is fine; the button only looked blank because it sits under that fade.

AC3 (no box-shadow): Header.module.css contains zero box-shadow declarations, so no shadow can paint under the sticky nav row at any scroll position; nav row uses border-bottom:1px var(--color-border) only.

AC1 (unique move): at 768/1024/1440 the single .plaque element spans both rows (36px strip + 64px nav = 100px) with one hairline right border touching strip and nav — one element, not a per-row logo. Verified visually and in markup.

AC2 (mobile): at 505 the header is one 32px nowrap contact row (status chip) + one 60px sticky logo/hamburger row; socials hidden, no city/county text, desktop CTA cluster hidden, hamburger 44x44. Satisfied (aside from the broken logo image in header-1-01).

AC5/AC6: nav is lean (no Home/About/Contact); on /used-cars the 'Used cars' item shows the 2px primary underline + aria-current (DOM), and isActiveRoute uses startsWith(href+'/') so /used-cars/<slug> keeps it active.
AC7: overlay markup verified in Header.tsx — rows min-height:56px, visible 44x44 ✕ close button, and .overlay[hidden]{display:none!important} present.
AC8: header nav-row bottom is a clean 1px --color-border hairline handing off to the home stub (bg) and to the used-cars page-ribbon — no gap, no shadow, no double border.

OUT OF SCOPE for header, flag for other reviewers: (a) styles/base.css std-link-color-blanket BLOCKER (global-styles component); (b) /used-cars page-ribbon renders as a claret PRIMARY band, whereas design-language §7 specifies the used-cars page-ribbon on `surface` — page-ribbon component's concern; (c) used-cars inventory grid shows horizontal overflow / clipped cards at 1024 (inventory component).
